title: Check: Effect of Catalysts on Rate

questions.stem: Which statement correctly describes how a catalyst works?

options.text: It provides an alternative reaction pathway with a lower activation energy
It increases the temperature of the reaction mixture
It increases the energy of the reacting particles
It increases the concentration of the reactants

questions.explanation: A catalyst provides an alternative reaction pathway with a lower activation energy. This means more particles already have sufficient energy to react when they collide, increasing the proportion of successful collisions and therefore the rate.
